top3.headline: NVIDIA IS TURNING AI DEMAND INTO A FINANCIAL FLYWHEEL
top3.summary: Nvidia posted Q2 revenue of $96.22B, topped EPS estimates ($2.22 vs. $2.09 expected), and guided to roughly 70% revenue growth into fiscal 2028. Shares surged 8.7% and dragged the Nasdaq up 1.6% on the day.
top3.whyItMatters: Nvidia is now the single biggest swing factor in US equity indices. When it beats big, it doesn't just move its own stock — it resets the market's entire AI-capex thesis for the next two quarters.

social.carouselIdea: 3 slides: the revenue number, the growth guide, the stock pop — and what it implies about AI capex through 2028.
social.bestHook: Nvidia didn't just beat earnings — it just told Wall Street how big AI gets from here.

top3.headline: THE FED JUST GOT A NEW PROBLEM
top3.summary: New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh used his first Jackson Hole address, on August 28, to warn that inflation isn't beaten — saying the central bank "has more work to do" and signaling that further rate hikes, not the cuts markets had priced in, are back on the table.
top3.whyItMatters: Markets spent the summer betting on a September cut. A hawkish pivot from a brand-new Fed chair — sworn in just three months ago — changes the calculus for stocks, bonds, and the dollar heading into the next FOMC meeting, and tests how much credibility a new chair wants to spend on an inflation fight investors thought was over.
top3.keyNumberLabel: gold price per ounce, a record high, as investors hedge the inflation risk

social.carouselIdea: 3 slides: 1) Everyone priced in cuts. 2) Warsh just said 'more work to do.' 3) What a hawkish Fed chair means for your portfolio.
social.bestHook: The market priced in rate cuts. The new Fed chair just said not so fast.
social.keyStat: Gold hits record $4,608/oz on the inflation-hedge trade

top3.headline: SALESFORCE'S AI BET STARTS PAYING OFF — WITH ANTHROPIC ALONG FOR THE RIDE
top3.summary: Salesforce shares jumped 22.6% — its best single-day move in years — after posting EPS of $5.90 against a $3.27 estimate and revenue of $11.35B. Executives credited accelerating Agentforce adoption, and the company launched a new "Claudeforce" AI plugin built with Anthropic.
top3.whyItMatters: This is one of the first big enterprise-software earnings beats that management explicitly attributes to AI agents actually selling and closing work, not just powering demos — a data point the market has been waiting for.
top3.keyNumberLabel: single-day stock move, Salesforce's largest in years

social.carouselIdea: Salesforce + Anthropic just previewed what the AI-agent economy looks like when it starts generating revenue.
social.bestHook: Salesforce's stock just had its best day in years — because AI agents finally started selling.

stories.headline: US M&A ACTIVITY IS RUNNING HOT INTO THE SECOND HALF
stories.text: US merger and acquisition deal value hit $1.11 trillion in the first half of 2026, a pace that puts dealmakers on track for one of the busier years since the 2021 boom.

stories.headline: THE LABOR MARKET ISN'T CRACKING — YET
stories.text: Weekly jobless claims came in at 203,000 for the week ending August 22, down 4,000 from the prior week, giving the Fed one less reason to rush toward cuts.

stories.headline: VOLATILITY IS DRAINING OUT OF THE MARKET
stories.text: The VIX fell 4.6% to 14.51 on Thursday, its calmest reading in weeks, even as investors braced for Warsh's Friday remarks.

stories.headline: CHIPMAKERS RODE NVIDIA'S COATTAILS
stories.text: Broadcom (+4.5%) and Intel (+4.4%) both rallied alongside Nvidia as the semiconductor sector benefited from renewed confidence in AI capex.

markets.title: MARKETS
markets.note: Levels reflect Friday, August 28 close / early Saturday reads where markets are closed for the weekend.

stories.headline: TECH CARRIED THE TAPE
stories.text: The Technology Select Sector SPDR (XLK) jumped 3.2% Thursday — the only S&P sector to advance — as the Nvidia and Salesforce beats overwhelmed everything else in the index.

stories.headline: NVIDIA'S GUIDANCE IS THE REAL STORY, NOT THE BEAT
stories.text: Beyond the Q2 numbers, Nvidia's ~70% revenue growth guidance for fiscal 2028 is the market's clearest signal yet that AI infrastructure spending isn't slowing down through the decade.

stories.headline: SALESFORCE AND ANTHROPIC TEAM UP ON "CLAUDEFORCE"
stories.text: Salesforce's new Claudeforce plugin, built with Anthropic, is a bet that enterprise AI agents need a foundation-model partner rather than a purely in-house model stack.

stories.headline: AI STARTUP FUNDING KEEPS FLOWING DESPITE STRETCHED VALUATIONS
stories.text: Fresh rounds this week for AI and robotics startups including Emerald AI, Gatik, and Stellaria point to investors still backing AI infrastructure and applied-AI plays even as public-market AI valuations draw more scrutiny.

stories.headline: NVIDIA (NVDA)
stories.text: Shares +8.7% after a record $96.22B revenue quarter and a bullish multi-year growth guide.

stories.headline: SALESFORCE (CRM)
stories.text: Shares +22.6%, its sharpest single-day move in years, on an AI-agent-driven earnings beat.

stories.headline: BROADCOM (AVGO) & INTEL (INTC)
stories.text: Both up more than 4% as semiconductor names caught a bid alongside Nvidia's earnings-driven rally.

stories.headline: WILL WARSH'S HAWKISH TONE SURVIVE UNTIL THE NEXT FOMC MEETING?
stories.text: Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks read as hawkish, but he has not committed to a specific rate decision. Whether "more work to do" translates into an actual hike — or just a longer hold — is still developing, not confirmed.

stories.headline: HOW BOND MARKETS DIGEST A HAWKISH NEW FED CHAIR
stories.text: Treasury yields have been volatile around Fed commentary this week; watch Monday's open for whether the bond market pushes back on Warsh's inflation warning.
